Revenue is the largest of the segments, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,639,494 million. Revenue including internal transactions, as cited in management's analysis, fell ¥94.4 billion (△5.4%) from the previous year to ¥1.6434 trillion, mainly due to a lower gas sales unit price under the raw material cost adjustment system. Gas sales volume for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 6,560 million m3, and the number of gas supply contracts was 5,161 thousand. The number of low-voltage electricity supply contracts was 1,946 thousand. In January 2026, Unit 1 of the Himeji Natural Gas Power Plant (generation capacity of approximately 620,000 kW) began commercial operation, and in May 2026, Unit 2 also began commercial operation. The gas pipeline business is handled by subsidiaries such as Osaka Gas Network Co., Ltd., sales to residential customers by Osaka Gas Marketing Co., Ltd., and sales to commercial and other customers by Daigas Energy Co., Ltd.

entries.b485f9aab2e56c02: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,030,302 million, a decrease of ¥38.7 billion (△1.9%) from the previous year. entries.cc7579dd97e44c2d: OSAKA GAS CO., LTD., headquartered in Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, and its 154 subsidiaries and 114 associated companies make up the group. The group is called the Daigas Group, and its business is divided into three [[term:segment|reportable segments]]: Domestic Energy, Overseas Energy and Life & Business Solutions. As of March 31, 2026, the number of consolidated employees was 21,835. Each role is shared among [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]], such as Osaka Gas Network Co., Ltd. for gas pipelines, Osaka Gas Marketing Co., Ltd. for sales to household customers, and Daigas Energy Co., Ltd. for sales to business and other customers.

entries.d7cd7051a3cff0ff: Describing itself as 'a group of companies that contributes to the further evolution of living and business,' it states that it aims to create value for customers, society, shareholders and employees through energy such as natural gas, electricity and LPG and related services, and through products and services in urban development, materials and information. Under the long-term management vision 2030 'Going Forward Beyond Borders,' formulated in 2017, and the medium-term management plan 2026 'Connecting Ambitious Dreams,' formulated in 2024, it sets out the priority strategy 'Three Promises' (co-creation of future value, improvement of employees' brilliance, and evolution of management foundations), and states that it aims to practice portfolio management with Domestic Energy, Overseas Energy and Life & Business Solutions as its three pillars.
entries.dfc2cb98fe93f8a8: In Japan, city gas is produced from LNG and other raw materials and delivered through pipelines for sale. LNG transportation for the company is carried out by Osaka Gas International Transport Co., Ltd., and Osaka Gas Gorgon Pty Ltd in Australia sells LNG to the company. Electricity is sold to the company by Senboku Tennen Gas Hatsuden Co., Ltd., Nakayama Nagoya Kyodo Hatsuden Co., Ltd., Himeji Tennen Gas Hatsuden Co., Ltd. and others. Unit 1 of the Himeji Natural Gas Power Plant (generation capacity of approximately 620,000 kW) began commercial operation in January 2026, and Unit 2 (approximately 620,000 kW) began commercial operation in May 2026. Overseas, Sabine Energy Inc. produces and develops shale gas in Texas, USA, and is also involved in the Freeport LNG liquefaction facility in the United States and in natural gas business in Australia. In India, DAIGAS SJ CGD PTE. LTD. is investing in city gas business. Outside energy, there are real estate development and leasing, software development and information processing services, and manufacture and sale of fine materials, carbon products and activated carbon.
